# Ascendra Academy

> The AI learning partner that walks beside you — interactive learning paths, an AI tutor, and earned certificates. Master GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3, Sora 2, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs and more in 2026.

## What Ascendra is

Ascendra Academy is a self-paced learning platform that teaches modern AI literacy through interactive paths. Each path is composed of bite-sized lessons with knowledge checks, fill-in-the-blanks, and hands-on prompt playgrounds. Learners earn shareable certificates as they complete paths.

## Core surfaces

- [Home](https://ascendraacademy.com/): hero, plans, learn-by-doing pitch.
- [Pricing](https://ascendraacademy.com/pricing): three tiers (Ascender $9.99/mo, Pathfinder $19.99/mo, Sage $29.99/mo).
- [Paths catalog](https://ascendraacademy.com/paths): curated AI learning paths plus user-generated paths.
- [AI models directory](https://ascendraacademy.com/models): 22+ models that matter in 2026 with descriptions, providers, and tier guidance.
- [AI Tutor](https://ascendraacademy.com/tutor): 1:1 conversational tutor powered by Claude Sonnet 4.5.
- [Learn hub](https://ascendraacademy.com/learn): long-form AI guides.
